note: Design-grade summary for the VP blueprint. Grades: measured | observed | vendor-claimed | inferred | computed (this step, two-proportion normal approximation, alpha 0.05 two-sided, power 0.8, same formula as l6 power.py; reproduces l6's 1,565 for 50->45).

learnable_targets.target: Contact facts and preferences (language, script, aap/tum, pace, stated best time, promised date, objections heard, opt-out)
learnable_targets.signal: exact caller quote with episode id and span
learnable_targets.method: proposal -> predicate gate -> auto-apply (opt-out, language) or review
learnable_targets.grade: measured (harvest recall@8 95.7%; live adherence trial FAILED once)

learnable_targets.target: Turn-taking parameters (endpointing hold, interruption sensitivity, backchannel timing) per segment
learnable_targets.level: per tenant segment, later per contact pace
learnable_targets.signal: cut-in and reply-gap events measured in code per turn
learnable_targets.volume: cut-in 25%->18%: 540 turns/arm unclustered; ~70-165 calls/arm at 8-12 turns/call and ICC 0.05-0.2
learnable_targets.method: fixed-horizon two-arm on local metric, reply-gap guardrail

learnable_targets.target: Opening (the useful-first slot after the locked disclosure)
learnable_targets.signal: early hang-up (<10 s) from telephony + TTS clause timestamps
learnable_targets.method: fixed-horizon two-arm; disclosure is locked and never a variant
learnable_targets.evidence: l6 report s.4.8 hazard curve (first turn 0.15 assumed)

learnable_targets.signal: hang-up time aligned to TTS clause timestamps, no LLM label
learnable_targets.volume: 2x line found 19% / 67% / 94% at 100 / 500 / 1,000 calls; fix confirmed ~592 calls/arm on local hazard; a catastrophic line (most callers leaving at one line) is visible within tens of calls
learnable_targets.method: Bayesian hazard flag P(>1.25x curve)>=0.99, then L3 fix test

learnable_targets.level: per segment (connect rate); per contact only as stated preference plus pickup history prior
learnable_targets.signal: connect / answered events from telephony, no outcome delay
learnable_targets.method: Beta posterior per hour bucket inside the legal window; discounted for drift

learnable_targets.signal: LLM clusters objections (proposal only); variant judged on 'call continues past objection' then outcome

learnable_targets.volume: effects likely small: TTS vendor choice moved intro hang-up only 87.9-90.3% over ~99,400 calls
learnable_targets.method: listener panel + language matching; dialect matching opt-in only

learnable_targets.target: Business outcome (renewal paid, promise-to-pay, site visit)
learnable_targets.signal: earned in code: CRM disposition, payment webhook, booking
learnable_targets.volume: 20%->22%: 6,510/arm; 20%->25%: 1,094/arm; Thompson only from ~1,000 calls/day on one script
learnable_targets.method: fixed horizon or always-valid; held-out AIPW readout; winners expire 60-90 d

never_learned: prices, offers, amounts, dates (data, not prose)

harness2_mapping.system_prompt: brief v2 shape + agenda ledger (middle slots only are editable)
harness2_mapping.guardrails: locked sections + code predicates (disclosure, crisis, opt-out, category fence, hang-up guard); diff must be empty
harness2_mapping.memory: compiled contact memory slot (bounded, whole entries, source ids)
harness2_mapping.tool_guidance: when to look up policy/payment, talk-while-waiting fillers
harness2_mapping.subagents: post-call extractor, objection clusterer, compliance classifier, summariser
harness2_mapping.skills: on-demand playbooks: objection packs, segment packs, language/register packs (cost nothing until loaded)
harness2_mapping.scripts: deterministic code: date and EMI math, window engine, number formatting
harness2_mapping.plugins: turn-taking middleware: endpointing, barge-in, backchannel, filler, silence nudges

omnichannel_sources.take: name, phone, policy/loan id, product, amount, due date, language, last interaction, deny flags
omnichannel_sources.grade: observed (l3/l4c: renewal lists arrive as spreadsheets)

omnichannel_sources.take: contact fields, stage, owner, last activity, new-lead webhook; write back dispositions and outcomes
attempt history, hang-up timestamps, dispositions, recordings -> hazard priors, best time, objection corpus
inbound questions and stated preferences inside the 24 h window, link clicks; never train beyond the business's exclusive model (Meta s.4.7)
delivery and click events, DLT template ids, post-call Rule 3 notice link
written commitments and replies as episodes
the one recent action that makes the opener useful (e.g. stopped at KYC step 3); consent-checked
paid / link opened (leading indicator), due amount; outcome earned in code
policy number, expiry, premium, NCB; highest authority rank; India residency
